title: The Predictive and Prognostic Value of ADAM28 Expression in Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma Patients.
snippet: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) is an aggressive and common subtype of non-Hodgkin lymphoma. Although ADAM28 is expressed in various cancers, it is considered a gene with ambivalent prognosis, and its association with clinical outcomes in DLBCL requires further investigation.
